Sin of Pride

Life between Sin And Grace

Prerequisite: Sin Feat. You can't have another Sin or Grace Feat.

You embody the essence of Pride, carrying within you the power and arrogance of Lucifer. This manifestation grants you supernatural resilience, an imposing presence, and the ability to reject any outcome that would place you beneath another.

You gain the following benefits:

Devil Inside

You gain the Fiend Creature Type in addition to your other Creature Types.

Demonic Lore

The Seven Demon Princes have witnessed countless ages and remember the history of the world. You have Advantage on History checks.

Manifestation of Pride

You embody superiority and perfection. You have Advantage on Acrobatics and Intimidation checks.

Avatar of Lucifer

Your mind is unyielding, and your ego refuses to be broken. You have Resistance to Psychic damage.

Sin of Lucifer

When you take damage, are hit by an attack, or fail a saving throw, you can take a Reaction to reject that outcome. You can use this feature to protect yourself from damage or an attack. You take half damage that triggered this feature.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

Level 3

When you use Sin of Lucifer to protect yourself from an attack or damage, you take no damage and suffer no other effects from the attack or damage that triggered this feature.

Level 5

You can now use Sin of Lucifer when you fail a saving throw. You instead succeed on that saving throw, suffering no effects that would occur as a result of failing it.

Level 7

When you use Sin of Lucifer to negate an attack or the effects of a failed saving throw, you can cause the effect to be reflected back upon its source.

If you reflect an attack, the attack is resolved against its original attacker, using the same attack roll and comparing it against the attacker's AC. The attacker can still make any saving throw normally allowed by the attack.

If you reflect the effects of a failed saving throw, the creature that caused the saving throw must instead suffer the effects of that failed save.

Level 9

When you use Sin of Lucifer to negate an attack or the effects of a failed saving throw, the creature that caused the triggering effect takes an extra Psychic damage equal to 1d6 for each level you have.

Level 11

You regain the use of Sin of Lucifer when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

Additionally, at the start of each of your turns, roll a 1d6. On a roll of 6, you regain the use of Sin of Lucifer.

Level 13

When you reflect an attack using Sin of Lucifer, you can choose one of the following effects:

  • The reflected attack is a Critical Hit.
  • The target automatically fails any saving throw caused by the reflected attack, and the attack deals the maximum damage instead of rolling its damage dice.

Level 15

When you die, you can use Sin of Lucifer to reject your death. You return to life with Hit Points equal to half your Hit Point maximum, and you suffer no negative effects from dying. The creature that caused your death takes Psychic damage equal to the total damage you took during the current turn.

You can use Sin of Lucifer even if you are unconscious or otherwise unable to take actions or reactions.

Level 17

After you use Sin of Lucifer, you gain immunity to all damage and all conditions until the end of your next turn.

Additionally, the extra Psychic damage dealt by Sin of Lucifer changes from 1d6 per level you have to 1d12 per level you have.
